headline: Executive order lets federal employee Paul H. Maurer keep working past the age when he would normally have to leave his job.
what_it_does: This order exempts one federal employee, Paul H. Maurer, from the rule that would require him to leave federal service. Some federal jobs, such as certain law enforcement roles, have a mandatory separation age. The title does not say what job Maurer holds or how long the exemption lasts.

who_it_affects.how: He may stay in his federal job instead of being required to leave under the mandatory separation rule.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 6, 2023; the length of the exemption is not stated in the title.
